findings.evidence: Lines 52–53 define `FiniteDual k H := WithConv (Module.Dual k H)` with no finiteness assumption; the existing `FGComoduleCat.dual` precedent in `TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/Finite/Dual.lean:42–49` is instead restricted by its finite-dimensional source category.
findings.fix: Require `[FiniteDimensional k H]` in the abbreviation, or rename the unrestricted carrier/namespace to describe the convolution linear dual and reserve `FiniteDual` for the finite-dimensional construction.
findings.issue: `FiniteDual` is available for every module but abbreviates the entire `Module.Dual`; outside finite dimension, “finite dual” conventionally denotes a restricted subspace, so the public name misidentifies the object.

summary: The main type name denotes the ordinary linear dual without imposing finiteness, conflicting with the standard meaning of “finite dual.”
